act_name: Servicemember Quality of Life Improvement and National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2025 (Copyright Provision)

lines.text: (A) the Secretary of Defense, with respect to a covered institution described in any of subparagraphs (A) through (K) of paragraph (2);
(B) the Secretary of the Department in which the Coast Guard is operating, with respect to the covered institution described in subparagraph (L) of such paragraph;
(C) the Director of National Intelligence, with respect to the covered institution described in subparagraph (M) of such paragraph; and
(D) the Secretary of Transportation, with respect to the covered institution described in subparagraph (N) of such paragraph.
(4) Covered work.-The term "covered work" means a literary work produced by a covered author in the course of employment at a covered institution for publication by a scholarly press or journal.
